title: WhatsAppBotDataSchemas
description: Comprehensive JSON Schemas for the WhatsApp Report & Document QA Bot system.

IncomingWhatsAppWebhook.title: Incoming WhatsApp Webhook Payload
IncomingWhatsAppWebhook.description: Cleaned JSON dictionary created from Twilio WhatsApp POST Webhook form data.

from.description: Sender WhatsApp ID in E.164 format with whatsapp: prefix

to.description: Recipient WhatsApp ID (Twilio Sandbox / Business Number)

body.description: Text content of the incoming WhatsApp message
body.example: What is classification in machine learning?

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of message reception

profile_name.description: WhatsApp profile name of the sender

num_media.description: Number of media attachments sent with the message

media.description: List of media attachment URLs and MIME content types

content_type.description: MIME type of the media attachment

BotQAResponse.title: Bot Document QA Response Payload
BotQAResponse.description: Response schema generated by the RAG QA engine when replying to a user's question.

answer.description: AI-generated answer based on document context
answer.example: Decision Tree is a supervised learning algorithm used for classification...

ReminderJob.title: Scheduled Reminder Job
ReminderJob.description: Schema representing a scheduled voice call reminder job.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the scheduled reminder job

to_number.description: Recipient phone number or WhatsApp ID

reminder_text.description: Text reminder to be spoken during the voice call
reminder_text.example: Call John regarding the project report

run_date.description: ISO-8601 formatted date and time when the reminder call will trigger
